title: A protocol for imaging microvilli biogenesis on the surface of cultured porcine kidney epithelial cell monolayers
protocol: Split CL4 cells from a T-75 flask when they reach 70–80% confluency.
Rinse the cells once with DPBS.
Add 2 mL of 0.05% trypsin to the cells.
Incubate the cells at 37°C for approximately 3 minutes.
Resuspend the cells using 8 mL of CL4 media.
In a 35 mm glass bottom dish, add 300 μL (∼2 × 10^5 cells) in 1.7 mL of CL4 media with appropriate selection antibiotics.
Incubate at 37°C for 16 hours and use the dish for imaging once cells grow to ∼50–80% confluency.
Confirm the presence of cells in sub-confluent islands or recently reached confluency using transmitted light microscopy before loading samples into the microincubation chamber.
Load a glass bottom dish containing appropriate cell density into the microincubation chamber maintained at 37°C with 5% CO2 and humidity.
Use CL4 medium with phenol red for imaging.
Alternatively, use Fluorobrite supplemented with 10% FBS and 1% L-glutamine for imaging.
Find a cell expressing the protein(s) of interest using a 100×/1.49 NA oil immersion objective.
Determine if the cell is suitable for observing microvillus growth events based on specified criteria.
Ensure that protein(s) of interest are expressed at moderate levels adequate for imaging without causing aberrant localization or phenotypes.
Confirm that microvilli are sparse enough to observe nascent microvillus growth events.
Design acquisition routine in Nikon Elements “ND Acquisition” window.
Configure lambda (channel series) settings.
Select the excitation/filter set of interest, FITC X1 (488) and TRITC X1 (561).
Configure time interval and duration.
Set standard time interval to 30 s for a 30 min duration.
Adjust time interval and duration based on experimental needs.
Set laser power to no more than 4% and exposure time to no more than 100 ms.
Set z-step size to achieve Nyquist sampling or less, typically 0.18 μm or less.
Set Perfect Focus to the middle of a symmetric imaging volume, starting at 4 μm above and below midpoint.
Set order of experiment to Lambda(Z series) for acquisition of total imaging volume per channel before switching channels.
Press “1 time loop”.
Scroll through imaging volume to see if a majority of the apical surface volume is captured.
Adjust the middle focal plane and press “1 time loop” if necessary.
Repeat step 3 if a majority of the apical surface volume is still not captured.
Run the acquisition.
Set up file path to ensure automatic saving.
Press “Run Now”.
